gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-padyakke-expande: Padyakke Expanded One is a text serif with wide-mouthed c shapes and letters strung out like knots on a slack rope. Balsamiq Sans above it keeps one stencil-cut weight and no pinched curves, so the two feel bold and bookish at once.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-bhutuka-expanded-one: Wrench-like and unapologetic, Baumans draws every stroke at one thickness, with a crescent c flung open. BhuTuka Expanded One, a text serif, slows the pace to a leisurely walk with curvy, unclamped letters, so the page moves from a shout to a stroll.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-stint-ultra-expanded: Crisp and mechanical, Baumans opens its crescent-wrench c wide and keeps every stroke at one thickness. Stint Ultra Expanded floats each serif character apart.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-bhutuka-expanded-one: Distinctive from the first line, Bellota hangs the ends of its s far from the spine and traces every stroke with one stylus width. BhuTuka Expanded One brings a literary, slow-walking serif, with thin joins as sturdy as its stems, and the two feel like a bold note beside a patient voice.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-padyakke-expanded-one: Stylus-drawn and bold, Bellota lets its s ends hang far from the spine over round, wide-mouthed lettering. Padyakke Expanded One's serif bowls hold their walls.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-hepta-slab: Commanding in its open shapes, Bellota Text has no calligraphic shading to steer the eye. And Hepta Slab, stretched-out and bookish, lets a long passage drift along with open counters breathing into the white space.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-bhutuka-expanded-one: Counters that stay connected to the outside give Bruno Ace its lingering, one-character-per-beat rhythm and ruler-drawn line. Bruno Ace announces; BhuTuka Expanded One, a curvy serif, carries.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-kiwi-maru: Ruler-straight and unhurried, Bruno Ace lets each character take its own beat. Bruno Ace is built to announce, while Kiwi Maru, a serif with terminals stopping far from the stem and generous letterspace, is built to read.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-stint-ultra-expanded: Stint Ultra Expanded reads as a text serif of characters floating apart, each one pipe-cleaner thin and open. Bruno Ace holds the heading with a ruler-drawn, constant-width line, so the two sit together with a kind of spaced-out authority.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-hepta-slab: Bruno Ace SC spreads its open-apertured letters like beads on a long thread, with no calligraphic thinning anywhere. But Hepta Slab is the one that settles in, its open counters breathing into the white space of a bookish, dignified serif.
